name: High Seas
source:
After being shipwrecked and stranded on a desert island, you are rescued by a ship of pirates. The bad news is you've become their hostage, but the good news is they don't plan on harming you... for now. Since there's still a couple of weeks before the ship arrives at the next port, you're pretty much stuck with this rowdy band of buccaneers until then. How will you make the best of your situation?

In "High Seas", you are a male human who goes on an adventure around a fantasy world with a pirate crew full of furries and scalies, with the possibility of romancing the men. Some will easily warm up to you, but others will take time. After all, you aren't a part of their crew... or are you? That possibility is up to the choices you make.

[From [url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/highseas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遭遇海难并搁浅在荒岛上后，你被一艘海盗船救起。坏消息是你已经成为他们的人质，但好消息是他们暂时不打算伤害你。由于距离船到达下一个港口还有几周的时间，在此之前你几乎会被这群吵闹的海盗困住。你将如何充分利用你的情况？

在《公海》中，你是一名男性人类，与一群毛茸茸的、有鳞片的海盗一起在奇幻世界中冒险，并有可能与这些男人发生浪漫关系。有些人很容易就会对你产生好感，但另一些人则需要时间。毕竟，你不是他们的船员……是吗？这种可能性取决于你所做的选择。

[来自[url=https://gatrgroh.itch.io/highseas]Itch.io[/url]]
